english_draft: Broadcom will report fiscal 2026 Q4 results around December 9, 2026. The prior quarter, fiscal Q3 ended August 2, 2026, showed revenue of about USD 29.6 billion, up 86% year over year. GAAP operating income was USD 16.0 billion. Non-GAAP operating income was USD 20.1 billion. AI semiconductor revenue reached USD 16.7 billion, up 221% year over year, according to the CEO statement. Operating cash flow was USD 14.2 billion. Capital expenditure was USD 0.5 billion. Free cash flow was USD 13.7 billion. For fiscal Q4, the company guided revenue to about USD 34.8 billion. It expects AI semiconductor revenue of USD 21.7 billion. Three core questions for the quarter: first, whether total revenue lands near the guided USD 34.8 billion; second, whether AI semiconductor revenue meets the company forecast of USD 21.7 billion; third, whether non-GAAP operating margin changes from the prior quarter level. Positive surprise could come from AI revenue above USD 21.7 billion. Negative surprise could come from weaker non-AI semiconductor demand or margin pressure. Key verification points in the earnings report: actual revenue, GAAP and non-GAAP operating income, AI semiconductor revenue, operating cash flow, capital expenditure, free cash flow, and any updated outlook.
